periods.office: Deputy Prime Minister; Minister of Energy Transition and Water Transformation (PETRA)

metrics.justification: No personal corruption charge or conviction of record. A November 2024 police probe concerned a forged letter using his name, in which he is the named victim, not a subject; a sibling's appearance in 1MDB-related reporting is not the subject's status and is not recorded against him.

citation.title: Police launch probe into forged letter bearing DPM Fadillah's name

metrics.justification: Disputed TNB's 26 Dec 2024 Bursa filing claiming approval for a 14% base-tariff rise, stating on 27 Dec 2024 that his ministry and the Energy Commission had not approved it and the schedule was still being finalised. Prompt correction of a market-moving claim, but the episode exposed coordination gaps; mixed (anchor 2).

citation.title: 2025 power tariff still under review, says Fadillah

metrics.justification: Championed the Energy Efficiency and Conservation Act 2024 (royal assent 14 Nov 2024, gazetted 26 Nov 2024, enforced 1 Jan 2025 with the Energy Commission as regulator) and the restructured RP4 electricity tariff (in force 1 Jul 2025); the energy-transition and hydrogen roadmaps remain framework targets. Gazetted reforms delivered alongside aspirational roadmaps (anchor 3).

Announced Phase II amendments to the Water Services Industry Act 2006 and moves to strengthen the National Water Council as the federal-state water-coordination platform; the amendments were not yet confirmed gazetted, so institution-strengthening is partial (anchor 2).

citation.title: Amendments to Water Services Industry Act to enhance regulation — Fadillah

metrics.justification: Went on record (27 Dec 2024) disputing TNB's public claim that a tariff rise had been approved. On-record candor, but a correction of another party's claim rather than a reversal of his own stated position (anchor 2).

citation.title: Poser over who approved electricity tariff hike after DPM Fadillah disputes TNB's claim
